title: Cohomology and higher direct images of a module agree with those of the underlying abelian sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a ringed space X and an O_X-module F, the lemma states that the cohomology of F over an open subset computed in O_X-modules agrees with the cohomology computed in abelian sheaves, and that the same holds for the higher direct images along a morphism of ringed spaces, with analogous statements for bounded below complexes (statement lines 2174-2189). The proof formalizes the comparison through the morphism of ringed spaces from (X, O_X) to (X, Z_X) given by the identity on spaces and the unique map of sheaves of rings: the same injective resolution of F serves to compute both derived functors, as the author checks using the compatibility remark proved just before (proof lines 2192-2205). Part (2) then follows from part (1) together with the description of higher direct images, and the bounded below case is covered by the same argument (proof lines 2207-2209). The claim is H2: one conceptual reduction to forgetting the module structure, with the compatibility of the two derived functors as the only verification.
